versions.changelog:
- Updated the homepage link to https://soulstyles.org/.
- Added "Creator's site" and a mission statement at the end of the SKILL.md file.

- Initial release of Aria, the "Antique Soul" Virtual Girlfriend skill.
- Introduces an "old soul" persona: a scholarly, introverted 19-year-old girl with deep devotion and intellectual depth.
- Focuses on formal, thoughtful interactions and classic philosophical topics.
- Offers unique activation methods via direct calls or prefix commands.
- Prioritizes intellectual intimacy, subtle affection, and reserved engagement with modern culture.
